Welcome to the official Lotterywest YouTube channel. 

Each week Lotterywest gives Western Australians a chance to dream through playing a range of lottery games. 

These include Saturday Lotto, OZ Lotto, Powerball, Millionaire Medley, Set for Life, Super66, Cash 3 and a great range of Scratch’n’Win tickets. 

It’s thanks to Western Australian players who purchase these games that Lotterywest is able to raise funds to support Western Australian hospitals, sports and arts groups, and thousands of community groups across the State.

By playing Lotterywest games, you get to help your dreams and those of WA, come to life.
